description: Prepare and verify the existing backend and frontend environment without changing source files, using the pinned Node runtime and the configured disposable test database.
steps: Select Node 22.11.0 with source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.11.0; confirm the pre-existing git worktree changes remain untouched.
Install backend dependencies with npm install in backend/ and generate Prisma Client with npm run db:generate.
Install frontend dependencies with npm ci in frontend/.
Run npx prisma validate in backend/ and apply the currently committed migration set to TEST_DATABASE_URL only, without resetting either database.
Run the baseline backend npm run test:unit, npm run test:performance, and npm run build commands.
Run the baseline frontend npm run test and npm run build commands, recording any pre-existing failures in findings.
acceptance_criteria: Node 22.11.0 is active for all npm commands.
Prisma Client generation and schema validation complete successfully.
No source or migration file is changed by environment setup.
Baseline backend unit tests, performance integration tests, and build pass, or any pre-existing failure is recorded with its exact command and error.
Baseline frontend unit tests and build pass, or any pre-existing failure is recorded with its exact command and error.
verification: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.11.0 && cd backend && npm run db:generate && npx prisma validate
